rootMeta.description: Free JSON, Base64, UUID, timestamp, JWT, PDF, and image utilities. Fast, private-by-default tools for developers and everyday work.

home.headline: Practical tools for developers, files, and everyday dates
home.lead: {siteName} runs lightweight utilities in your browser whenever possible. No accounts are required for the core toolkit—start with JSON formatting, timestamps, time zones, PDF merge, and image compression.

toolsIndex.title: All tools
toolsIndex.description: Browse free online utilities: JSON, Base64, UUID, JWT, timestamps, time zones, calculators, PDF merge, and image compression.
toolsIndex.lead: Browse by category or open the tool you need. Each tool has its own page so it stays fast and easy to focus on one task.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.description: Format, validate, and minify JSON in your browser.

uuidGenerator.title: UUID Generator
uuidGenerator.description: Generate random UUID v4 identifiers instantly.

base64.title: Base64 Encode / Decode
base64.description: Encode or decode Base64 with proper UTF-8 handling.

timestamp.description: Convert Unix time, milliseconds, and ISO-8601 strings.

jwt.title: JWT Decoder
jwt.description: Inspect JWT header and payload (decode only, no verification).

regexTester.title: Regex Tester
regexTester.description: Test JavaScript regular expressions against sample text in your browser.

diffChecker.title: Text Diff
diffChecker.description: Compare two texts line by line and highlight additions and removals.

jsonToCsv.title: JSON to CSV
jsonToCsv.description: Turn a JSON array of objects into a comma-separated table you can paste into a spreadsheet.

cronGenerator.title: Cron Expression Helper
cronGenerator.description: Build common cron schedules and preview upcoming run times.

markdownPreview.title: Markdown Preview
markdownPreview.description: Write Markdown on the left and see the rendered preview on the right in your browser.

timeZone.title: Time Zone Converter
timeZone.description: Compare the same moment across regions, with daylight saving handled.

dateCalculator.title: Date Calculator
dateCalculator.description: Add or subtract days and compute the difference between dates.

ageCalculator.title: Age Calculator
ageCalculator.description: Calculate exact age from a birth date.

loanCalculator.title: Loan Payment Calculator
loanCalculator.description: Estimate monthly payment, total paid, and interest for a fixed-rate loan.

roiCalculator.title: ROI Calculator
roiCalculator.description: Compute return on investment as a percentage from starting and ending amounts.

imageCompressor.title: Image Compressor
imageCompressor.description: Shrink JPG, PNG, and WebP images locally in your browser.

pdfMerge.title: PDF Merge
pdfMerge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one download.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.metaDescription: How {siteName} handles analytics, uploads, and local processing.
privacyPage.intro: {siteName} ("we") provides free online tools. This page explains what data may be collected and how uploads are handled.
privacyPage.pLocal: Many utilities (JSON, Base64, UUID, timestamps, JWT decode, time zones, date math, image compression) run entirely in your browser. That processing does not leave your device unless you explicitly download a file.
privacyPage.pPdf: When you merge PDFs, files are sent to our server only for the duration of the request. We do not use your documents for training or marketing. Temporary data should be discarded immediately after the response is sent—avoid uploading sensitive documents if your threat model requires zero server transit.
privacyPage.pAnalytics: We may use Google Analytics 4 to understand aggregate traffic. You can control cookies through your browser and any consent banner we enable when advertising partners are added.
privacyPage.pContact: For privacy questions, contact the site operator using the address published on this domain once available.

termsPage.pChanges: We may update these terms or discontinue features. Continued use after changes means you accept the revised terms.
